title: Dim picture, sluggish controls
backstory: Operator reports the picture looks washed out and the trackball feels heavy. Cabinet has been running for several years without a cap refresh.
visible_effect: MAME framebuffer darkened by Lua overlay; trackball dx/dy reduced in-game
diagnosis_hint: Measure 5 V rail at J1 pin 4 with a DMM. Should read 5.05 V; anything below 4.8 V indicates a sagging supply.
